an6.25:1.4: ‘iti pi so Bhagavā . . . pe . . . Sattā devamanussānaṃ buddho Bhagavā' ti.
an6.25:1.5: Yasmiṃ bhikkhave samayena ariyasāvako Thathāgataṃ anussarati, nev'assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapuriyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an6.25:1.6: ujagatam ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā,
an6.25:1.7: gedho ti kho bhikkhave pañcann' etam kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
an6.25:1.8: Idam pi kho bhikkhave ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evam idh' ekacce sattā visujjhanti. 3.
an6.25:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave ariyasāvako dhammaṃ anussarati
an6.25:2.2: ‘svākkhāto Bhagavatā dhammo . . . pe . . . paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī' ti.
an6.25:2.3: Yasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye ariyasāvako dhammaṃ anussarati, nev'assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapuriyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an6.25:2.4: ujugatam ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā,
an6.25:2.5: gedho ti kho bhikkhave pañcann' etam kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
an6.25:2.6: Idam pi kho bhikkhave ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evam idh' ekacce sattā visujjhanti. 4.
an6.25:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave ariyasāvako saṅghaṃ anussarati
an6.25:3.2: supaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho . . . pe . . . anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā' ti.
an6.25:3.3: Yasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye ariyasāvako saṅghaṃ anussarati, nev'assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an6.25:3.4: ujugatam ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā,
an6.25:3.5: gedho ti kho bhikkhave pañcann'etaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
an6.25:3.6: Idam pi kho bhikkhave ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evam idh' ekacce sattā visujjhanti. 5.
an6.25:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave ariyasāvako attano sīlāni anussarati akhaṇḍāni . . . pe . . . samādhisaṃvattanikāni.
an6.25:4.2: Yasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye ariyasāvako sīlaṃ anussarati, nev'assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an6.25:4.3: ujugatam ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā,
an6.25:4.4: gedho ti kho bhikkhave pañcann'etaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
an6.25:4.5: Idam pi kho bhikkhave ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evam idh' ekacce sattā visujjhanti. 6.
an6.25:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave ariyasāvako attano cāgaṃ anussarati
an6.25:5.2: ‘lābhā vata me suladdhaṃ vata me . . . pe . . .
an6.25:5.3: yācayogo dānasaṃvibhāgarato' ti. Yasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye ariyasāvako cāgaṃ anussarati, nev'assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, ujugatam ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā, gedho ti kho bhikkhave pañcann'etaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ. Idam pi kho bhikkhave ārammaṇaṃ
an6.25:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ bhikkhave ariyasāvako devatā anussarati
an6.25:6.2: ‘santi devā Cātummahārājikā, santi devā Tāvatiṃsā, santi devā Yāmā, santi devā Tusitā, santi devā Nimmānaratino, santi devā Paranimmitavasavattino, santi devā Brahmakāyikā, santi devā Tatuttari;
an6.25:6.3: yathārūpāya saddhāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayham pi tathārūpā saddhā saṃvijjati;
an6.25:6.7: paññāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayham pi tathārūpā paññā saṃvijjatī' ti.
an6.25:7.1: Yasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye ariyasāvako attano ca tāsañ ca devatānaṃ saddhañ ca sīlañ ca sutañ ca cāgañ ca paññañ ca anussarati, nev'assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an6.25:7.2: ujugatam ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā,
an6.25:7.3: gedho ti kho bhikkhave pañcann'etaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
an6.25:7.4: Idam pi kho bhikkhave ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evam idh' ekacce sattā visujjhanti.
